en_title: Captain Price Actor Sends Message to Fans as Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Campaign Praise Rolls in
cn_title: 《《使命召唤：现代战争4》》普莱斯演员感谢好评，呼吁勿剧透
subtitle: 让玩家按自己的节奏体验
opus_summary: 《使命召唤：现代战争4》战役收获玩家好评，IGN给出8分。普莱斯扮演者Barry Sloane发文致谢，并呼吁玩家暂时不要剧透，让其他人按自己的节奏体验。

paragraphs.en: Barry Sloane, the actor behind Call of Duty's Captain Price, has shared a message with fans as praise for Modern Warfare 4's campaign rolls in.
paragraphs.cn: 《现代战争4》战役好评不断，《使命召唤》系列中普莱斯上尉的扮演者Barry Sloane也向粉丝发来了一则消息。

paragraphs.en: Early reactions to Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4's story mode have filled social media feeds in the first 24 hours since early access players dived in – and most of them seem to be quite positive. Fans online have called it one of the more "brutal" and "intense" campaigns the series has ever seen, with many going as far as to say it holds its own against classic stories featured in games like the original Modern Warfare 2 and Black Ops.
paragraphs.cn: 抢先体验玩家进入《使命召唤：现代战争4》后的头24小时里，社交媒体上涌现了大量对剧情模式的初步评价，其中大多数似乎都相当正面。网上的粉丝称，这是系列迄今较为「残酷」「紧张刺激」的战役之一。不少人甚至认为，它足以媲美原版《现代战争2》和《黑色行动》等作品中的经典剧情。

paragraphs.en: It appears to be a winner for publisher Activision and developer Infinity Ward that critics like, too. While Steam reviews paint a "Very Positive" picture, IGN awarded this year's set of story missions an 8/10 . Our reviewer said the Modern Warfare 4 campaign made them "feel something for the series again," adding that it managed to send the reboot saga series out "on a high note."
paragraphs.cn: 对发行商Activision和开发商Infinity Ward来说，这部作品似乎取得了成功，也赢得了媒体的认可。Steam评价为「特别好评」，IGN则为今年的战役打出了8分，满分10分。我们的评测者表示，《现代战争4》的战役让自己「再次对这个系列有了感情」，并称它为重启后的系列故事「画上了精彩的句号」。

paragraphs.en: "The MW4 campaign was a 10/10 for me, they made a good story and ended it," one recent Steam review said . "Damn near almost cried at the end LOL."
paragraphs.cn: 最近一条Steam评测写道：「《现代战争4》的战役在我心里是满分10分。他们讲了一个好故事，也为它画上了句号。结尾真差点把我看哭了，哈哈。」

paragraphs.en: As reviews continue to trickle in, many have taken the time to praise Sloane's work as Captain Price, specifically. The star behind Activision's most recent incarnation of the Task Force 141 leader took to social media to respond to the "kind words" he's received.
paragraphs.cn: 随着评价陆续出炉，不少人还专门称赞了Sloane对普莱斯上尉的演绎。在Activision最新版本的故事中，他饰演141特遣队的这位领袖。他也在社交媒体上回应了大家送来的「赞美」。

paragraphs.en: "Thank you for all the kind words," he said. "I see them. I read them. And I am grateful."
paragraphs.cn: 他说：「谢谢大家的所有赞美。我都看到了，也都读了。我心怀感激。」

paragraphs.en: As Infinity Ward sought to end this Modern Warfare storyline with the 2026 Call of Duty game, it should come as no surprise to see that the developers took big swings in its story. With that said, full-on, untagged Modern Warfare 4 campaign spoilers have already started to show up across feeds, too. There's not much Activision can do about that, but Sloane used his message as an opportunity to ask fans to keep unfiltered reactions to themselves, at least for now.
paragraphs.cn: Infinity Ward希望用2026年的《使命召唤》为这条《现代战争》故事线收尾，因此开发团队在剧情上大胆尝试，也就不足为奇了。不过，社交媒体上也已经开始出现毫无遮挡、未标注剧透警告的《现代战争4》战役内容。Activision对此也没有太多办法，但Sloane借这次发文，请粉丝至少暂时不要直接发布未经处理的感想，以免剧透。

paragraphs.en: "Remember," he continued, "let's allow people to enjoy the game in their own time. No spoilers. Bravo 6 – Dark."
paragraphs.cn: 他接着说：「记住，让大家按自己的节奏享受游戏。不要剧透。Bravo 6——保持静默。」
